about: Questions whose answer is NOT in the 12 sample documents. 'off_topic' = nothing to do with the company. 'near_topic' = sounds like the documents (leave, salary, holidays, IT ...) but the answer is not there. Written by hand by the project author, who checked each one against the document text. Used to test the 'I don't know' rule: the assistant must NOT answer these.
